identification: Lot of about 15 vinyl LPs, mostly 1970s-80s Australian and US rock. Identified from photos: Buffalo 'Mother's Choice' (Vertigo 6357 103, Australia 1976, the cover with the woman in a gold heart, matched to the Discogs release 5361804 cover), Matt Taylor LP with kookaburra cover, The Powder Blues (Band), Boogie Brothers (Decca), Gunther Gorman 'Infectious Rhythm', D.C. Cab soundtrack (sealed look), Atlanta Rhythm Section, REO Speedwagon, Company Caine, and several others not legible. The Buffalo is the standout; Discogs shows it at median A$145 (low A$79.99, high A$295, last sold Jan 2026).
